USAGE:
    dtk [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    dtk pipe build
    dtk init claude
    dtk init claude --dir /path/to/project --force
    dtk init copilot
    dtk init copilot-cli

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    dotnet                Run dotnet commands with filtered output              
    pipe <subcommand>     Filter output piped in from a command dtk did not run 
    init <provider>       Install dtk integration artifacts for an AI assistant 
                          provider                                              
    config                View or modify dtk configuration                      
    doctor                Run diagnostics to verify dtk is set up correctly     
    completion <shell>    Print shell completion script                         
    gain                  Show token savings analytics                          
    log                   Show the full output of a previous run                
    reset                 Clear all tracking data

Usage: dotnet [runtime-options] [path-to-application] [arguments]

Execute a .NET application.

runtime-options:
  --additionalprobingpath <path>   Path containing probing policy and assemblies to probe for.
  --additional-deps <path>         Path to additional deps.json file.
  --depsfile                       Path to <application>.deps.json file.
  --fx-version <version>           Version of the installed Shared Framework to use to run the application.
  --roll-forward <setting>         Roll forward to framework version  (LatestPatch, Minor, LatestMinor, Major, LatestMajor, Disable).
  --runtimeconfig                  Path to <application>.runtimeconfig.json file.

path-to-application:
  The path to an application .dll file to execute.

Usage: dotnet [sdk-options] [command] [command-options] [arguments]

Execute a .NET SDK command.

sdk-options:
  -d|--diagnostics  Enable diagnostic output.
  -h|--help         Show command line help.
  --info            Display .NET information.
  --list-runtimes   Display the installed runtimes.
  --list-sdks       Display the installed SDKs.
  --version         Display .NET SDK version in use.

SDK commands:
  build             Build a .NET project.
  build-server      Interact with servers started by a build.
  clean             Clean build outputs of a .NET project.
  format            Apply style preferences to a project or solution.
  help              Opens the reference page in a browser for the specified command.
  msbuild           Run Microsoft Build Engine (MSBuild) commands.
  new               Create a new .NET project or file.
  nuget             Provides additional NuGet commands.
  pack              Create a NuGet package.
  package           Search for, add, remove, or list PackageReferences for a .NET project.
  publish           Publish a .NET project for deployment.
  reference         Add, remove, or list ProjectReferences for a .NET project.
  restore           Restore dependencies specified in a .NET project.
  run               Build and run a .NET proj

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Filter output piped in from a command dtk did not run

USAGE:
    dtk pipe <subcommand> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dtk pipe build

ARGUMENTS:
    <subcommand>    The dotnet subcommand whose filter to apply, e.g. build or  
                    list package                                                

OPTIONS:
                       DEFAULT                                                  
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -v, --verbose                 Echo the resolved command line before running 
        --vv                      Also dump the raw dotnet output and elapsed   
                                  time                                          
        --show-log                Print the path to the full log file when the  
                                  output was saved                              
    -q, --quiet                   Suppress all DTK meta-output; forward only the
                                  filtered content                              
        --exit-code    0          Exit code of the command that produced the    
                                  output (default 0)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install dtk integration artifacts for an AI assistant provider

USAGE:
    dtk init <provider> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dtk init claude
    dtk init claude --dir /path/to/project --force
    dtk init copilot
    dtk init copilot-cli
    dtk init copilot-cli --global
    dtk init gemini
    dtk init cursor
    dtk init windsurf
    dtk init aider
    dtk init jetbrains

ARGUMENTS:
    <provider>    AI assistant provider to set up (claude, copilot, copilot-cli,
                  gemini, cursor, windsurf, aider, jetbrains)                   

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Prints help information                                     
    -d, --dir       Target project root directory (default: current directory)  
    -f, --force     Overwrite existing files instead of skipping them           
    -g, --global    Install into the user's home config (claude, copilot-cli,   
                    gemini, aider) instead of a project

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Show token savings analytics

USAGE:
    dtk gain [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dtk gain
    dtk gain --days 7
    dtk gain --project
    dtk gain --json

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help        Prints help information                                   
        --days        Number of days of history to include (default: 30)        
        --project     Filter by current project directory                       
        --json        Output raw JSON instead of table                          
        --export      Export raw tracking records in the given format (csv)     
        --command     Filter results to a specific command (e.g. build, test,   
                      format, list package)                                     
        --coverage    Report which commands run unfiltered, ranked by tokens at 
                      stake

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Show the full output of a previous run

USAGE:
    dtk log [subcommand] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dtk log
    dtk log build
    dtk log --list
    dtk log --full

ARGUMENTS:
    [subcommand]    Only show logs for this dotnet subcommand, e.g. build or    
                    list package                                                

OPTIONS:
                   DEFAULT                                                      
    -h, --help                Prints help information                           
        --list                List the available logs instead of printing one   
        --index    1          Which of the matching logs to show, newest first  
                              (default 1)                                       
        --lines    100        How many trailing lines to print (default 100)    
        --full                Print the whole log instead of a trailing window  
        --all                 Include logs from every project, not just this    
                              directory
